directory.title: Chat directory
directory.info: Pick this project when you start a session: each new session gets its own child directory under the root.

root.label: Root directory
root.hint: A leading ~ is expanded. Empty falls back to your home directory.

prune.label: Clean up empty directories
prune.hint: Delete empty chat-<date>-<time>-<random> session directories a week old. Other folders in the root are never touched.

save.label: Save settings
save.done: Saved. The next new session uses the new directory.

register.label: Register as a Paseo project
register.hint: Use this when the directory exists but the project list does not show it.

reset.label: Reset project name to app language
reset.hint: Renames the project to Chat or 聊天, following the app language.

problem.cliUnavailable: The paseo CLI could not run ({{detail}}). Run paseo project create {{path}} in a terminal.
problem.projectRegisterFailed: Could not register the project: {{detail}}. Run paseo project create {{path}} in a terminal.
problem.projectRenameFailed: The project is registered, but renaming it failed: {{detail}}
problem.notRegistered: {{path}} is not a Paseo project yet. Register it below, or run paseo project create {{path}} in a terminal.
problem.settingsUnreadable: Plugin settings could not be read. Fix them on this page first.
